summary:
Implementation plan for Phylogenesis expansion:
1. Exoplanetary Scenarios: Tidally Locked Eyeball World with permanent Twilight habitable ribbon, and Super-Earth (2.5g) with high-density atmospheric and square-cube biomechanical constraints.
2. Interactive vDNA Gene Editor: Visual genetic laboratory with Hox gene segment regulation, metabolic codon editing, and real-time morphological sprite generation.
3. Dynamic Weather & Lighting System: Procedural 16-bit cloud banks, rain storms, atmospheric circulation, and day-night lighting terminator.
